name: Black Widow BW-PLHD-JACK ProLift Cruiser Motorcycle Center Jack
description: Black Widow ProLift portable steel motorcycle center jack makes the task of lifting a Cruiser or V-Twin off the ground for maintenance quick and painless. Position the scissor jack under the bike's frame and turn the hex head bolt to raise a motorcycle from 4" to 15" height in a matter of minutes; Designed for lifting the front or rear wheel only. Suitable for shop or garage tire, brake, and chain servicing or for use with lift tables. Black Widow ProLift center jack safely supports up to 1,100 pounds maximum and includes two 3.5" and two 5.25" removable rubber padded height adapters for added frame clearance and protection. Includes a hex head socket handle for operating. Weighs 32 pounds. Made from heavy-duty steel construction and features a durable engine orange paint finish.
